entities.name: Boc-protected aniline
observations: Reactant is CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1cccc(-c2cc(=O)cc(N3CCOCC3)o2)c1, as decoded from the supplied SELFIES.

entities.name: Free aniline product
observations: Product is Nc1cccc(-c2cc(=O)cc(N3CCOCC3)o2)c1 after N-Boc removal.
The aryl-linked oxygen heterocycle, ketone, and morpholine substituent are conserved.

entities.name: N-Boc deprotection
observations: Exact matching ORD record ord-318215a35818485784ab3fafd77411b4 transforms the Boc-protected aniline to the free aniline using TFA in DCM.
Transformation cleaves the N–C(=O) carbamate bond and converts the protected nitrogen to NH2; the remaining scaffold is unchanged.
